question: Until when could regulators grant derogations from the 15-minute imbalance settlement period, and what limit applies from January 2025?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 8(4) of Regulation 2019/943 states that derogations may be granted only until 31 December 2024. It also states that from 1 January 2025 the imbalance settlement period shall not exceed 30 minutes where all regulatory authorities in a synchronous area have granted an exemption. The reference answer matches this.", "other_articles": [{"doc_id": "reg_2017_2195_art53", "answers": "partially", "why": "It sets the 15-minute imbalance settlement period and lets TSOs request exemptions. verdict.gold_reason: Article 8(4) of Regulation 2019/943 states that derogations may be granted only until 31 December 2024. It also states that from 1 January 2025 the imbalance settlement period shall not exceed 30 minutes where all regulatory authorities in a synchronous area have granted an exemption. The reference answer matches this.

other_articles.why: It sets the 15-minute imbalance settlement period and lets TSOs request exemptions. It gives no 31 December 2024 cut-off and no 30-minute limit.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question maps directly to Article 8(4) of Regulation 2019/943.
